Headquarters: Remote

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform teams within the Platform Engineering organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role responsible for the foundational systems that store, ingest, and evolve the data powering ZoomInfo's entire go-to-market product suite.

You will lead a team of senior engineers across two core areas:

•       GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable), spanning scaling, performance, operational reliability, and the change data capture (CDC) systems that capture and propagate data change events downstream.

•       ZoomInfo Data Platform — ZoomInfo's analytical data store (BigQuery), including the ingestion pipelines and onboarding systems that bring new data in and keep it flowing accurately and efficiently, and the processes that ensure customer data deletion requests are handled promptly and compliantly.

This role sits at the foundation of ZoomInfo's data infrastructure — the reliability, scale, and integrity of these systems directly determine how fast we can onboard new data and how confidently we can serve it to customers. You will manage senior technical talent directly, setting technical direction, unblocking hard problems, and holding a high bar for engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

•       Lead and develop a team of senior engineers and tech leads across GTM Store and the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Set the roadmap across both areas, balancing scaling and performance needs, new data onboarding velocity, compliance obligations, security and platform reliability.

•       Build a high-performance engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, and operational excellence for systems operating at large scale.

•       Manage senior technical individual contributors directly — setting expectations, providing technical guidance, and developing career growth paths for staff-level and senior engineers.

•       Serve as a trusted partner to the VP of Software Engineering, contributing to broader platform engineering strategy.

•       Establish clear prioritization frameworks to manage competing demands across scaling, new data onboarding, compliance, and reliability work.

GTM Store

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable) powering the go-to-market data product.

•       Drive scaling initiatives to keep pace with data growth and increasing query/read-write demands from downstream products.

•       Guide architecture decisions to improve performance, latency, and cost-efficiency at scale.

•       Establish and maintain operational best practices — monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and incident response — to ensure high availability.

•       Own the strategy and architecture for change data capture (CDC), ensuring data change events are captured, propagated, and consumed reliably by downstream systems, including the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Guide the selection and evolution of CDC tooling and patterns to support real-time and near-real-time data change propagation at scale.

•       Ensure CDC systems maintain data consistency, ordering guarantees, and fault tolerance under high event volume.

•       Partner with Product and downstream engineering teams to understand data access patterns and evolve the store's schema, APIs, and change event streams accordingly.

ZoomInfo Data Platform

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the ZoomInfo Data Platform — the analytical data store (BigQuery) that consumes and serves data for downstream analytics and product use cases.

•       Own the architecture and roadmap for data ingestion pipelines, including those consuming CDC streams from the GTM Store, that bring new data sources into the platform.

•       Drive initiatives to ease and accelerate the onboarding of new data sources, reducing the engineering lift required to integrate each new dataset.

•       Establish standardized, repeatable ingestion patterns and tooling that shorten time-to-value for new data.

•       Ensure ingestion pipelines are reliable, observable, and scalable to handle growing data volume and variety.

•       Own the systems and processes that handle customer data deletion requests, ensuring they are executed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and related regulations.

•       Partner with Legal/Compliance and Product to evolve data deletion workflows as privacy regulations and customer requirements change.

•       Build observability and auditability into deletion workflows to provide clear evidence of compliance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

•       Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements for scaling, new data onboarding, and compliance work that inform the platform roadmap.

•       Drive enablement programs — documentation and tooling — that help internal teams onboard new data sources faster and with less friction.

•       Represent the GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform in strategic planning conversations and technology decisions with company-wide implications.

What You Bring

Required

•       8+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering or data engineering, with experience operating at a senior leadership level.

•       Experience directly managing senior technical talent — staff engineers, tech leads, or senior ICs — and holding a high technical bar.

•       Strong working knowledge of large-scale operational (e.g., BigTable) and analytical (e.g., BigQuery) data stores and distributed systems, including experience scaling data infrastructure to handle high volume and throughput.

•       Experience with data ingestion pipeline architecture and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Debezium, Kafka Connect, Kafka, or similar streaming/CDC tooling).

•       Experience with data privacy and compliance practices, including handling data deletion / right-to-be-forgotten requests under GDPR/CCPA.

•       Demonstrated ability to balance platform reliability and performance work against feature and onboarding velocity.

•       Proven cross-functional partnership skills with product and business stakeholders.

•       Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership.

Preferred

•       Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data infrastructure, including BigTable and BigQuery.

•       Familiarity with event streaming platforms (Kafka) and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar).

•       Experience building self-service tooling that accelerates data onboarding for internal teams.

What Sets You Apart

•       You lead through people. Your strongest technical asset is your ability to hire, develop, and empower exceptional engineers — and then get out of their way.

•       You connect technology to business outcomes. You see infrastructure investments not as technical projects but as enablers of speed, trust, and better decisions across the company.

•       You are a systems thinker. You see the connections between platform architecture, team structure, process design, and stakeholder experience — and you optimize across all four.

•       You are decisive under ambiguity. Competing priorities, legacy systems, organizational change, and imperfect information don't paralyze you — they sharpen your focus.

About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Enterprise Workload is a unified server backup and archival built on Druva’s secure, enterprise-trusted, and high-performance cloud platform. With Phoenix, data can be stored indefinitely with limitless snapshots and flexible retention policies, while at the same time significantly lowering your backup costs. Druva takes a multi-layered approach to securing data that is unmatched in the industry – enabling organizations to address both their data security and data privacy requirements.  

 

About Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal SDET who brings strong engineering fundamentals, deep automation capability, and a passion for quality in distributed, cloud-based systems. This role involves designing test strategies, improving automation frameworks, and working closely with developers to ensure the reliability and security of complex backup workflows.

You will contribute across the full lifecycle - from feature design and white-box testing to deployment and validation in cloud environments.

 

Principal Software Development Engineer (Principal SDET)
Roles and Responsibilities

  • Be part of the Agile development team and work closely with developers.
  • AI-Driven Quality Engineering: Evaluate, champion, and integrate AI-assisted testing tools and Generative AI workflows to accelerate test case generation, automation, and bug analysis.
  • Develop a deep understanding of product features and enhancements, including functional specifications and design, with a focus on automated and manual, white-box and black-box testing.
  • Plan, create, and manage the overall quality strategy.
  • Collaborate with developers during product design reviews and provide inputs on functional requirements to improve testability and automation.
  • Own end-to-end QA for medium to complex features.
  • Collaborate across teams to strategize and plan long-term solutions for overall product and feature quality.
  • Identify quality gaps and drive action items to address them.
  • Develop and maintain a model to estimate automation ROI and continuously improve it.
  • Evaluate and recommend new quality tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve productivity and quality.
  • Plan test cycles, provide estimates, monitor and track progress, and participate in bug triaging and quality metrics tracking.
  • Mentor and guide other SDETs on the team.
  • Ensure timely builds and effectively manage product deployments.
  • Drive reduction of overall COGS/Opex for test infrastructure.
  • Design and architect modular, scalable, and reusable automated testing solutions.


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
  • AI Tooling & Awareness: Practical experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Cursor) for code generation and debugging, with awareness of AI-driven testing solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Ability to estimate, prioritize, and plan work with technical leads.
  • Good understanding of operating systems (Windows and Linux).
  • Understanding of threads, multiprocessing
  • Good understanding of basic networking concepts.
  • Experience with bug and test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, etc.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git, SVN, etc.
  • Good shell scripting skills.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, Java.
  • Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware and Hyper-V.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture and concepts.
  • Experience with security, scale, and performance testing.
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases such as MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.
  • Experience building automation pipelines and working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
  • Experience designing automation frameworks and tools.
  • Knowledge of front-end web application test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Puppeteer.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and API testing/automation.
  • Understanding of Agile testing methodologies, test pyramid, and quality metrics.
  • Experience with white-box testing and methodologies such as TDD and BDD.
  • Experience mentoring QA/SDET teams.


Pluses

  • Cloud computing experience.
  • Storage domain experience.

About the Team
 
Did you know Meesho helped 9 million women start businesses with zero investment? Our Finance team has a key role to play in making a difference for the better in 9 million lives. Here’s your chance to be a part of this great impact!😎
 
As Business Finance Manager, you will be one among the 50+ professionals working in domains such as Financial Reporting, Finance Operations, Business Finance, Treasury Management and Taxation. The team consists of Chartered Accountants, Business experts and Engineers, who have previously worked for internationally renowned organisations. 
 
Our team believes in working hard and partying harder. We organise team trivia nights, board game marathons, and other fun events to foster our team spirit 💥.
 
About the Role
 
Let’s get financially responsible!
 
As Business Finance Manager, you will tell us how and where to spend our money. 
 
Plus, you will also manage business development activities according to a financial plan. You will modify financial plans and budget amounts based on the changes in business plans. You will also provide financial support and advice to management in closing business deals


What you will do
• Work closely with specific business units and actively participate in their operations

• Provide various business units insights from the finance side

• Jointly own the OKRs of the respective business units and build an AOP to achieve them 

• Develop financial plans along with various business and technology teams with a ‘bottom-up’ approach 

• Review the plans vs. actuals on a regular basis

• Do an in-depth analysis of variance and communicate the same to create visibility and enable planning of actionable 

• Track and measure key financial and business metrics for respective businesses.

• Complete account-level month-end closing reviews, procedures, and corrections as needed 

• Direct and oversee the overall policies, objectives, and initiatives of the revenue cycle 

• activities to optimise operations 

• Do a scenario analysis and develop business plans on product enhancement or business initiatives and present them to top management

• Handle ad hoc requests and problem-solving with a short turnaround time 

• Supplement ad hoc requests with appropriate analysis and comments to support decision making 

• Participate and drive standardisation automation projects for process efficiency 

• Conduct periodic meetings with direct reports

What you will need
• 4 to 6 years of experience as a Chartered Accountant or a Master’s degree in Financial Management

• Should have 3+ years of experience in Business Finance

• Strong analytical rigour and problem-solving skills 

• Proficiency in MS Office 

• Proven ability to form strong collaborations with stakeholders
